command: import copy,json; from work import evaluate; r={'declared':['z','a','z','ignored'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}},'a':{'kind':'missing'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'z':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'hash':'1','kind':'file'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}}; p={'ignored':['ignored']}; rb=copy.deepcopy(r); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got=={'needs_review':False,'changed':[]},got; assert r==rb and p==pb; r2={'declared':['b','a','b','same'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'same':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'},'b':{'kind':'dir','entries':[]}}}; got2=evaluate(r2,{'ignored':[]}); assert got2=={'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','b']},got2; print(json.dumps([got,got2],sort_keys=True))
